title: Flawless Greenhouse
keywords: Manual four-wide greenhouse with configurable interior length and two central crop columns

blocks.text: Manual four-wide greenhouse with configurable interior length and two central crop columns.

rows: Assemble Stable Stone ends, Flawless Glass walls and Bottom Quartz Slab roof.
Put the CO₂ Generator at the correct near corner with matching facing.
Use all fourteen seed inputs and supply FE.

blocks.text: It has no automatic Build or Demolish controls. Wrong slab half, a missing end pillar or an over-limit length invalidates the layout.

Read the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.
